note: Reference data — not a single-select config slot, so it is not listed in configs.json part_categories. These items apply to every build for safety/code.

spec.definition: Representative rating/spec for the tent-scale baseline

guidance: Do not skip overcurrent protection — a 48 V lithium bank can push thousands of amps into a fault. Follow NEC Article 690 (PV) / 705 and local code.
Class-T fuse on the battery main (high AIC for lithium fault current), sized just above max inverter/AC DC current.
Size conductors for ampacity AND <2-3% voltage drop over the actual run length; 12 V systems need much heavier cable than 24/48 V.
For a 1-week desert trip: house the battery + electronics in a sealed dust-proof tote/case with cable glands, keep it shaded, and stake/ballast the array against wind.

Per-config checklist: Class-T battery main fuse; per-string battery fuses if parallel; DC disconnects battery<->inverter and array<->controller; PV overcurrent if >=3 parallel strings; conductors sized for ampacity + voltage drop; grounding/bonding per NEC 690/705; AC branch breaker for the mini-split.

parts.name: Battery main fuse (Class-T)
parts.spec: Class-T, 125-200 A, 48 V DC (size per bus/load)
parts.purpose: Interrupts lithium's high fault current on the battery main
parts.notes: High AIC rating; size just above max inverter/AC DC current.

parts.name: Battery-to-inverter DC breaker/disconnect
parts.spec: 48 V DC breaker, ~125-150 A (scale to bus)

parts.name: Per-battery-string fuse
parts.notes: Every parallel string gets its own.

parts.name: PV string fuse / combiner
parts.purpose: Protects PV strings on parallel arrays
parts.notes: Needed when >=3 strings parallel; use PV-rated (not AC) fuses.

parts.name: AC output breaker
parts.purpose: Protects the AC branch to the mini-split
parts.notes: In a small load center/subpanel (AC path only).

parts.name: Battery cables
parts.notes: 12 V @60-80 A needs 2-4 AWG short runs; 24 V halves current.

parts.name: Grounding & bonding kit
parts.spec: Grounding electrode + equipment ground per NEC 690
parts.notes: Bond frames, disconnects, and negative per system requirements.

parts.name: Racking / ground mounts + stakes/ballast
parts.spec: Rated for panel size + wind load
parts.purpose: Hold the array at tilt; survive playa wind
parts.notes: Ground/tilt mounts ease cleaning; low + staked for desert wind.

parts.name: Sealed dust-proof enclosure + cable glands
parts.purpose: Protect battery + electronics from playa dust & heat
parts.notes: Keep shaded; heat derates battery and electronics.

parts.name: Shunt battery monitor (Victron SmartShunt)
parts.notes: Optional but invaluable for tuning duty cycle vs battery.
